title: ZhichaoTan/metrics_guidance_retrosynthesis: v1.0.0
description: Code for the graph edit distance (GED) calculation and the complexity-distance guided multistep retrosynthetic search described in "Guiding Computer-Aided Multistep Retrosynthesis with Complexity and Distance Logic" (Nature Computational Science). The archive includes the target sets and the buyable stock used in the study.
